text:
pat: Quick report from yesterday's onboarding: they downloaded the tarball on Linux, extracted into /tmp, ran ./redwoodctl and completed browser auth, but `redwoodctl whoami` returned unauthenticated.
nirav: /tmp run? that's our classic ephemeral-profile smell. What shows in `redwoodctl profiles list`?
pat: two entries: default -> /home/pat/.redwood and tmp-run -> /tmp/rwd-7f3a. Token ended up in /tmp.
sam: if the binary runs from an ephemeral dir we currently prefer a local config next to the binary as a fallback. That explains it.
liz: this keeps biting new hires. Can we detect common temp dirs (/tmp, Downloads, AppData\Local\Temp) and show a clear banner at startup advising to move the binary or use the distro package?
nirav: yes. Plan: 1) startup banner when binary path matches known ephemeral patterns; 2) emit telemetry event `installer.ephemeral_profile=true` (no PII); 3) add a `redwoodctl migrate --from <path> --to default` helper that copies tokens atomically and deletes the tmp copy after verification.
sam: QA matrix: add extract-to-/tmp case on linux, extract-to-Downloads on mac, unzip-to-Downloads on Windows, and symlinked-from-WSL. Ensure migrate preserves file perms.
liz: docs: Quickstart note to prefer package manager or move binary to ~/bin. Add troubleshooting snippet "I finished browser auth but CLI still shows logged out" with migrate steps.
support-bot: created support ticket DX-12034 with reproduction steps and recommended migrate command.
pat: small UX ask: when the login callback runs and detects a tmp profile, can we auto-print the migrate suggestion immediately? New hire closed terminal after browser and missed the banner.
nirav: we'll show the suggestion right after the callback and make it an interactive prompt for interactive sessions. For noninteractive shells we'll default to persistent path and log a warning.
sam: also add path normalization for `profiles list --json` so support can quickly see expanded paths. Unit tests will assert resolved paths.
liz: thanks team. This will reduce first-day friction significantly.
pat: confirmed staging shows the banner and the migrate hint; fixed my onboarding flow. :white_check_mark:
